independent_review: No remaining material picker findings after fixing memberless device eligibility, stale-count wording and focus after a filtered row disappears.

environment.browser: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/155.0.0.0 Safari/537.36

results.controls: Open picker, focus search, press the native Escape key
results.expected: Escape closes the picker, preserves the draft and returns focus to Choose batteries.
evidence: Native Escape preserved the draft and returned focus after search received focus on opening.

results.controls: Choose batteries, search by area and entity ID, select across the row
results.expected: Names retain area and floor; remaining duplicates show entity IDs; no save occurs.
evidence: Rendered controls and state assertions passed; 0 mocked save request(s).

results.controls: Watch batteries in areas, Show all areas, selected only
results.expected: Only areas with suitable batteries appear by default; selected empty areas remain visible.
evidence: Rendered controls and state assertions passed; 0 mocked save request(s).

results.controls: Watch batteries with labels, Show all labels
results.expected: Only relevant labels appear by default, and empty selections remain explicit.
evidence: Rendered controls and state assertions passed; 0 mocked save request(s).

results.controls: Loading, failed catalog load, complete catalog refresh
results.expected: Loading and retryable failures retain saved identities without claiming emptiness.
evidence: Rendered controls and state assertions passed; 0 mocked save request(s).

results.controls: Save policy, return to list, reopen
results.expected: The area selection persists; unrelated policy and delivery drafts remain unsaved.
evidence: Rendered controls and state assertions passed; 1 mocked save request(s).

results.controls: Invalid empty selection, rejected save, deliberate retry
results.expected: Invalid selection sends no request; failed save keeps the exact draft for retry.
evidence: Rendered controls and state assertions passed; 2 mocked save request(s).

results.controls: Full-width search, compact clickable rows, long name and narrow viewport
results.expected: Search and rows fit the viewport, retain accessible labels and meet touch target size.
evidence: Rendered controls and state assertions passed; 0 mocked save request(s).

limitations: Synthetic catalog and mocked saves; no live Home Assistant changes or notification requests.
The 390px native Escape row is untested in that run; the equivalent rendered keyboard path passed at 1280px and 320px.
resolved_verification_issues: The phone scenario now follows the visible Back to Policies control; the hidden editor return was an invalid test target.
The browser reload retained an older fixture; final checks used fresh tabs.
An intermediate required check had three History test failures during separate work; the final required check passes all frontend tests.
